title: orchis cordigera proles rochelii
intro: Orchis cordigera proles rochelii, commonly known as  Orchis mascula ssp. rochelii, is a type of orchid plant species. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in various cultures, particularly in the Middle East and Mediterranean regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Orchis cordigera proles rochelii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
